name: nested recovery: nested policy catch cannot see original offers
source:
on go
 try
  throw "original"
 offer recover value
  return value
 catch "original" before unwind
  try
   throw "inner"
  catch "inner" before unwind
   put offerAvailable("recover") into visible
  catch "inner"
  end try
  choose offer recover(visible)
 end try
end go

name: nested recovery: nested policy cannot choose an original offer
source:
on go
 try
  throw "original"
 offer recover value
  return value
 catch "original" before unwind
  try
   throw "inner"
  catch "inner" before unwind
   try
    choose offer recover(99)
   catch "offer unavailable"
    put 7 into replacement
   end try
  catch "inner"
  end try
  choose offer recover(replacement)
 end try
end go

name: nested recovery: helper failure exposes its own offers and resumes outer policy
source:
script variable seen
function helper
 try
  throw "inner"
 offer inner value
  return value
 end try
end helper
function work
 try
  throw "original"
 offer recover value
  return [value, seen]
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  return work()
 catch "original" before unwind
  try
   put helper() into replacement
  catch "inner" before unwind
   put [offerAvailable("inner"), offerAvailable("recover")] into seen
   choose offer inner(9)
  end try
  choose offer recover(replacement)
 end try
end go

name: nested recovery: locally handled policy error preserves writes and resumes selection
source:
on go
 try
  throw "original"
 offer recover value
  return value
 catch "original" before unwind
  put 4 into replacement
  try
   throw "policy"
  catch "policy"
   add 3 to replacement
  end try
  choose offer recover(replacement)
 end try
end go

name: nested recovery: escaping policy skips siblings and cleans policy before retained scopes
source:
script variable order = ""
function work
 try
  throw "original"
 offer recover
  return "unexpected action"
 finally
  put "work;" after order
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  try
   put work() into ignored
  catch "original" before unwind
   try
    throw "policy"
   finally
    put "policy;" after order
   end try
  catch "policy"
   return "sibling catch"
  finally
   put "catching;" after order
  end try
 catch e
  return [the code of e, the code of the during of e, order]
 end try
end go

name: nested recovery: policy and original finally scopes run once in transfer order
source:
script variable order = ""
function fail
 try
  try
   throw "original"
  finally
   put "deep inner;" after order
  end try
 finally
  put "deep outer;" after order
 end try
end fail
function work
 try
  put fail() into ignored
 offer recover
  put "action;" after order
 finally
  put "owner;" after order
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  put work() into ignored
 catch "original" before unwind
  try
   try
    choose offer recover
   finally
    put "policy inner;" after order
   end try
  finally
   put "policy outer;" after order
  end try
 end try
 return order
end go

name: nested recovery: locally handled transfer cleanup preserves pending choice and availability
source:
script variable visible = false
script variable order = ""
function fail
 try
  throw "original"
 finally
  try
   throw "cleanup"
  catch "cleanup"
   put offerAvailable("recover") into visible
   put "handled;" after order
  end try
 end try
end fail
function work
 try
  put fail() into ignored
 offer recover
  put "action;" after order
 finally
  put "owner;" after order
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  put work() into ignored
 catch "original" before unwind
  choose offer recover
 end try
 return [visible, order]
end go

source:

  put "owner;" after order

 try

name: nested recovery: transfer cleanup error can reach offering try catch
source:
script variable entered = false
function work
 try
  try
   throw "original"
  finally
   throw "cleanup"
  end try
 offer recover
  put true into entered
 catch {code: "cleanup"} as e
  return [the code of the during of e, entered]
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  return work()
 catch "original" before unwind
  choose offer recover
 end try
end go

name: nested recovery: action error cannot reach sibling catch or sibling offer
source:
function work
 try
  throw "original"
 offer recover
  throw "action"
 offer sibling
  return "unexpected sibling"
 catch "action"
  return "own catch"
 end try
end work
on go
 try
  return work()
 catch "original" before unwind
  choose offer recover
 catch "action" before unwind
  put offerAvailable("sibling") into visible
 catch "action"
  return visible
 end try
end go
